name: Independent stratified cached-hiring gameplay cohort
design: Independent accepted map/game seeds per arm. Randomize policy in balanced blocks within generator×player-mix strata after generating map inputs. Primary analysis does not pair divergent match trajectories.
ai_seats: Randomly shuffle each composition across team seats using input randomization independent of policy assignment.
scope: Standalone live material consumer. Original attraction/flying-carrier searches, hiring rounds/quotas/clocks/admission/subscriptions/swaps remain. No synthetic vacancies, stock/food changes or gameplay RNG use by diagnostics. No production integration.
secondary_metrics: deliveries and harvested material per worker exposure
winner AI composition and unresolved matches

analysis.unit: Match; teams and unit-ticks are clustered within each match, not independent observations.
analysis.rates: Aggregate event/exposure ratios, both overall balanced cohort and stratified generator/mix summaries. Preserve each match numerator and denominator jointly.
analysis.confidence_intervals: 95% stratified match-level bootstrap, resampling independently within each arm×stratum; 10000 draws.
analysis.tests: Two-sided policy-label randomization within each generator×mix stratum; 10000 permutations; Holm adjustment for the three primary endpoints.
analysis.stopping: Fixed1200 games, no outcome-dependent early stopping. Interim inspection only for execution/telemetry validity. No repeated significant-result stopping.
analysis.interpretation: Report effect sizes and uncertainty, not only p-values. A nonsignificant difference does not establish equivalence or pass the five-percent gameplay gate. This chosen generator/mix population does not represent all gameplay. Concurrent run timings are advisory, not a quiet-host performance benchmark.

failures: Retain all attempted games, stdout/stderr and statuses. Do not silently replace crashed/timed-out gameplay runs. Analyze technical-failure rates separately; gameplay estimates state missingness and are not accepted if policy failures cause differential missing outcomes. Map-generation failures retained before policy assignment; deterministic replacement seeds used until each stratum has100valid inputs.
evidence: Retain protocol/manifest hashes before results, binary/build/dependency provenance, input maps/reports, commands, per-match JSON and512tick cumulative telemetry, compact validation traces, all failures, analysis scripts and results. Preserve historical PR evidence.
